patterns.note: A clean, grid-based layout is consistently used for product displays and feature sections, maintaining clear visual separation and order.
All text, including headings and body copy, utilizes a single, neutral sans-serif font, reinforcing the minimalist and functional brand identity.

The design heavily relies on a muted, natural color palette of off-whites, light beiges, and greys for backgrounds, contrasted with dark grey/black text, creating a serene and understated visual experience.
The primary navigation bar transforms on scroll, shrinking in height and becoming a sticky, compact header at the top of the viewport.
Content sections are clearly delineated by generous vertical spacing and subtle background color shifts (e.g., white to light beige), often introduced by large, centered headings.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar dynamically reduces its height and fixes to the top of the screen as the user scrolls down, providing a persistent, space-efficient navigation experience. This likely uses GSAP for smooth transitions.
Product carousels, powered by Swiper, are employed to showcase multiple items or collections within a confined horizontal space, allowing users to browse through content efficiently.
The overall page structure uses a flexible grid system with consistent padding to arrange diverse content blocks, from product cards to informational modules, ensuring visual harmony and readability.

design_tokens.type_scale: Balanced and legible; headings are moderately larger than body text, with a consistent, understated sans-serif weight across all text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp; most elements feature crisp, 90-degree corners, with very subtle rounding only on interactive elements like buttons or input fields.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy; generous padding and margins create a sense of calm and order, particularly around product grids and section breaks, contributing to a minimalist feel.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its unwavering commitment to a minimalist, functional aesthetic that deeply reflects the MUJI brand philosophy. It avoids any superfluous design elements, instead relying on clean layouts, ample whitespace, and high-quality, natural product photography to convey a sense of calm, quality, and understated elegance.
